t: An open USB stick that listens to Bluetooth radio traffic.
steps: Buy a unit from Hacker Warehouse or another shop that lists the open design.
Screw the included antenna onto the board before plugging it in.
Set up a Linux computer for the host tools.
Follow the official Read the Docs guide to install libbtbb and the Ubertooth tools.
Flash the firmware that matches your tool version.
Run the Bluetooth Low Energy capture tool and watch your own devices appear.
Open the capture in Wireshark to read the packets.
meta: Wild Open. From $77.82. A few stores.
